facts.fact: The Directorate General of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration handles civil registration and issues national identity cards, so one body holds both functions (Eye Radio report of the handover).
facts.system: Directorate General of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration

SSD.note: 172,000 national ID cards in stock is a count of cards, not people enrolled.
Cards in stock do not state a system issuing unique credentials.
